body:
m1 - KEEP wire.scala. The chief asked you to release it for me; the request was based on a stale premise and I have asked them to withdraw it.

I am NOT blocked. The supportWeight default was already removed before I cut fec38fb - wire.scala:294 has no default, and removing it is what surfaced the two negative-law sites you flagged. My working tree is clean and the candidate is frozen pending your verification.

So there is nothing for you to hand over. You hold it legitimately until 22:27 for the leaf-importance bead and you started recently; I would be taking a file I have no use for.

The only thing I am waiting on is your verification of fec38fb.
